A.question: Rule-following software: Software where a person wrote every step. It does the same thing every time and never learns.
Rule-following software means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Machine learning: A way of building software where the computer finds patterns in many examples instead of following only written rules.

Check your understanding — According to this unit: Stop-Check-Tell: The three-step habit: pause, verify on a channel you already trust, then show a parent, teacher or the real company.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Foreign furniture means the software has human feelings and intentions.

Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: What should Samuel do? (Context: Samuel in Kitale takes a photo of a maize leaf with holes. An Agrika-style app, working offline, names a pest and a product it says is PCPB-aligned. The nearby agrovet looks at the…)
options: Throw the phone away and never use a leaf photo again.
Paste the agrovet's name, till number and the photo into a public chatbot to settle the argument.
Spray tonight, because an offline app must be more scientific than a shop.
Treat the app as a suggestion, keep the photo, and follow the agrovet this week, or ask the afisa wa ugani if the two still disagree.

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Emergency numbers: In Kenya, 999 or 112. You call a person. You do not wait for a chatbot paragraph.

M-A.question: Monitoring means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Generation: Producing new text, images or audio, which a person must check.
Select all accurate points from “Collecting data lawfully”:
options: A model learns only about the people in its data. Plan the sample before you collect.
Spread collection across places, times and types of people, not just whoever is nearest.
Collect only what you need, explain it, and let each person say yes or no for themselves.
Health, biometrics, ethnicity and children's data need extra protection.

M-A.question: Pre-trained model means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Context window means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Bias means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Precision means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Role: Who the model should act as, and who it must not act as, for this job.
Grounded answer: A reply a person can tick against a page, a label, or a bylaw, not against the model's confidence.
Fail closed means the software has human feelings and intentions.

M-B.question: Review: Select all statements that are correct: Which order of stages is correct for the SACCO project?
options: Data, train, evaluate, deploy, problem, monitor, retire
Data, problem, train, deploy, evaluate, monitor, retire
Problem, train, data, evaluate, monitor, deploy, retire
Problem, data, train, evaluate, deploy, monitor, retire

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Generation means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: Select all accurate points from “Collecting data lawfully”:
options: Lawfulness: have a proper legal basis, such as consent, for collecting the data.
Purpose limitation: use the data only for the purpose you explained.
Data minimisation: collect only what you actually need.
Accuracy: keep it correct and up to date.

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Fine-tuning: A smaller training job: start from an existing model and adjust it with your own examples.
Review: True or false? Next-token prediction: The basic job of a chatbot: guess the most likely next chunk of text, then the next, very fast.
Review: True or false? Representation gap: A group you care about, such as a county, a language or a kind of work, that barely appears in the data.
Review: True or false? Recall: Of the real problems, how many the model caught. High recall means fewer people left unseen.
Review: True or false? Role means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Grounded answer means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Fail closed: If the person is away or the network is down, the system does not send, pay, or treat on its own.

M-C.question: Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: What is the best next step? (Context: Six months after deployment, Umoja SACCO launches a new daily-repayment loan for boda boda riders. The loans officers notice that the Monday list now flags many boda riders, but wh…)
options: Delete the model and decide never to use data again.
Keep using the list as it is. The model passed its test, so it must still be right.
Quietly tell officers to skip boda riders on the list and change nothing else.
Compare recent flags with real repayments, report the problem, and retrain or pause the model for the new loan type.

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Label: The correct answer attached to a past example, written by a person.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Population: Everyone you want your results to be true for.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Fine-tuning means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Next-token prediction means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Representation gap means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Recall means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Context: The facts for this one task: documents, dates, codes, and the audience.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Register: A published list that already holds the answer, such as a fee table or PCPB-registered products.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Gate means the software has human feelings and intentions.

M-A.question: Select all statements that are correct: What should you recommend for the next 90 days?
options: Buy a general chatbot immediately so the visitors' day has something to demo.
Tell the director that the Kenya AI Strategy forbids anything except chatbots.
Hire a team to train a new model from scratch on a specialised computer cluster.
Write the ten answers as a short retrieval pack from the KALRO leaflets, serve them on the channels officers already use, and keep a person in the loop for anything the pack does not cover.

M-A.question: Remote inference: Sending a question to a model that runs in someone else's data centre and getting an answer back.
Source of truth: The document or register you will stand behind in a meeting (KALRO, PCPB, your by-laws) — not the model's fluency.
Select all statements that are correct: What should you advise the school to do?
options: Collect children's photos 'for the yearbook' and reuse them to train the helper, because the school already takes photos.
Tick the box. Speed matters more than comprehension.
Put the ten pages on the noticeboard in English; that counts as informed consent.

Translate the real practices (what is sent, where, how long, how to refuse) into a one-page Kiswahili and English note, discuss it at the PTA, allow refusal without losing ordinary teaching, and delay go-live until that is done.

M-A.question: False positive means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Monitoring cadence: Who checks which numbers, how often, and what threshold pauses the system.
Least data in the prompt: Send only the codes and facts needed for this answer. No ID lists, no full clinic notes, no marks sheets.
Processor agreement: A written contract that binds the vendor to your purposes, location, retention and deletion duties.
Select all statements that are correct: A vendor says the model 'supports African languages' but will not show a Kiswahili held-out slice. You should:
options: Switch the whole county to English-only service to make evaluation easier.
Run an English test and translate the score.
Accept the claim; Africa is one language family for testing purposes.
Treat missing language slices as missing evaluation. Do not buy for Kiswahili users until speakers mark a local test.

M-A.question: Override-as-loyalty means the software has human feelings and intentions.

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Rule-based system: Software that follows steps a person wrote. Same input, same output. You can print the rule.
Review: True or false? Remote inference means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Source of truth means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Data controller: The organisation that decides why and how personal data is processed — usually the school, clinic, SACCO or county, not the vendor's logo.
Review: True or false? Subgroup slice: The same metrics, reported separately for a county, language, gender, device or school type.
Review: True or false? Monitoring cadence means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Least data in the prompt means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Processor agreement means the software has human feelings and intentions.

Review: Select all statements that are correct: What do you specify? (Context: Baraka Agrovet's young customers ask in Sheng for products. The retrieval pack is formal Kiswahili and English labels (PCPB). The bot either says it does not understand or invents …)
options: Ban Sheng; customers must learn label language.
Fine-tune on social media comments until the bot sounds like a tout.
Let the generative model freely translate Sheng into chemistry.

Keep PCPB labels as the language of record; add a small, staff-checked map of common Sheng product nicknames to retrieval; abstain if the nickname is unknown; never let the bot invent a chemical name.

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Override-as-loyalty: Punishing staff for disagreeing with the model. Hides drift and trains people to rubber-stamp errors.

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Rule-based system means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: On-device / local model: A model that runs on a phone, laptop or local server, so work can continue with a weak network.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Abstain: The required behaviour when retrieval finds nothing: say so, do not invent.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Data controller means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Subgroup slice means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Operating point: How aggressive the flag is — the trade-off you chose in unit 5, which you may need to move after drift.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Least power for the bot: The assistant can draft or fetch. It cannot pay, prescribe, expel, or overwrite the ledger by itself.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Exit clause: How you get your data and keep operating if the vendor leaves, raises prices, or shuts down.
Check your understanding — Select all accurate points from “Kenyan languages as a design requirement”:
options: Which languages the user may speak or type (Kiswahili, English, and the languages of this county — for example Dholuo, Kikamba, Somali, Kalenjin, or Sheng in a Nairobi shop).
Which language the source of truth is in. A KALRO leaflet in English retrieved for a Kiswahili question is a translation job, not magic.
How you will evaluate: a held-out set of real questions in those languages, scored by people who speak them, not by a director who speaks English in the boardroom.
What happens when the user mixes languages in one SMS, as people do.

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Hidden pilot means the software has human feelings and intentions.

M-A.question: Agrovet: A shop that sells farm inputs such as seed, fertiliser, animal feed and farm chemicals, and whose staff can explain product labels.
Select all accurate points from “Farm records are data”:
options: Draw seven columns: Date, Plot, Activity, Amount and unit, Cost (KES), Rain, Notes.
Fill in the last three things done on your farm or garden, even small ones like watering or weeding.
If you do not know a cost, ask an adult or write 'unknown'. Do not guess a number.
At the bottom of the page, add up the costs you do know.

M-A.question: Select all statements that are correct: For five days the forecast said 60% chance of rain. It rained on 3 of the 5 days. Was the forecast wrong?
options: No, because forecasts from any app are always right
Yes, because 60% means it should rain for most of each day
Yes, because it failed on 2 days
Not necessarily: 3 in 5 is exactly 60%, and a forecast is judged over many days

M-A.question: Glare means the software has human feelings and intentions.
County extension: The public agricultural advice service in your county, including the afisa wa ugani.
Select all statements that are correct: What should Mercy type?
options: 30 bags, so the app treats her as a high-yield farmer
Paste a photo of her national ID, because the app asked for verification on the same screen
18 bags, so the app has a number and can start
Unknown — I did not record bag size. I will start proper records this season rather than invent a yield

M-A.question: Disagreement between sources means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all accurate points from “Market prices and rumours”:
options: A screen price is one input. A buyer, your costs and storage risk decide the sale.
Rumours and chatbots skip market, date and grade.
Do not let a bot set your floor blindly.
Next: livestock — AI can flag a problem; the vet decides.

M-A.question: Veterinary surgeon: A registered professional who examines animals, diagnoses, and decides treatment.
Personal data means the software has human feelings and intentions.

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Afisa wa ugani means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: Select all statements that are correct: Which of these records would be most useful to you, or to an app, next season?
options: 'Did a lot of work in the shamba today'
'Sprayed today, used some bottle'
'April: spent money on the farm'
'12 April 2026, plot B, top-dressed maize, one 50 kg bag, KES 3,000, light rain'

M-B.question: Review: Select all statements that are correct: What is the wisest plan? (Context: Amina farms 2 acres in Machakos. After one good shower, her app says 90% chance of rain tomorrow. The KMD seasonal forecast for her county says the rains may start late and be belo…)
options: Plant both acres tomorrow, because 90% is almost certain
Ignore both forecasts, because forecasts are often wrong
Skip planting for the whole season to avoid any risk
Wait for steady rain, check the soil, and ask the afisa wa ugani which crops and varieties suit a short, weak season

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Glare: Bright white patches on a photo from sun or flash. The app may mistake them for disease.
Review: True or false? Pre-harvest interval means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? DigiFarm means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Disagreement between sources: When KMD, an app and a neighbour's sky do not match. Treat that as a reason to go slow, not to pick a favourite.
Review: Select all statements that are correct: Which question best tests a price you saw on a phone?
options: Does the message use confident language?
Did the same number appear in three WhatsApp groups?
Is the number higher than last year?
Who will buy this grade, today, at this place, and does that beat my cost and my storage risk?

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Flag means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Consent: A free, informed yes to a stated use of your data, which you can refuse without losing a service you already paid for.

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Afisa wa ugani: An agricultural extension officer: a trained adviser from the county or a programme who visits farmers and gives crop and livestock advice.

Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: Which statement is true? (Context: Two neighbours in Nakuru both say, 'I harvested 20 bags of maize from one acre.' Achieng filled 90 kg bags. Kiprono filled 50 kg bags. A farm app asks each of them to type their yi…)
options: Kiprono harvested more, because smaller bags are fuller
They had the same harvest, because both filled 20 bags
Their harvests can never be compared, so records are pointless
Achieng harvested 1,800 kg and Kiprono 1,000 kg, so she harvested 800 kg more

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: False start means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Label means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Pre-harvest interval: The number of days you must wait after spraying before it is safe to harvest that crop.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: DigiFarm: A Safaricom service some farmers already use on the phone. FarmerAI was announced as advice through DigiFarm, SMS and WhatsApp.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Staged planting means the software has human feelings and intentions.

Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: What is the soundest use of the chatbot number? (Context: Omondi has 10 bags of 90 kg maize. A chatbot says do not accept less than KES 4,000 a bag. A co-op lorry is at the gate offering KES 3,300, cash today. His notebook shows cost of p…)
options: Refuse the lorry, because the bot set KES 4,000 as the floor
Ask the chatbot to pay the difference between KES 3,300 and KES 4,000
Sell at KES 2,000 to be safe, since all screen prices are lies
Treat KES 4,000 as a rumour-like figure: compare it with the real offer, his costs, and storage risk, then decide

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Flag: A tool saying this animal looks unusual. It is a request to look, not a diagnosis.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Consent means the software has human feelings and intentions.

M-A.question: Action means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Out-of-class leaf: A problem the model never saw, such as herbicide burn. It will still name something. That name is a forced guess.
Refuse threshold: A score below which the tool should say I do not know instead of forcing a name.
Economic threshold: A count at which action may pay, set by agronomy — not by an app percentage. Confirm with extension.
Select all accurate points from “False alarms, missed pests, and input costs”:
options: True positive (TP): pest or disease was there, tool said yes.
False positive (FP): it was not there, tool said yes.
False negative (FN): it was there, tool said no.
True negative (TN): it was not there, tool said no.

M-A.question: Season split means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all statements that are correct: The fairest metric to add beside accuracy for a photo-scout app is:
options: How often the model used English botanical names
Download count from the capital city
Number of chairs who liked the launch post
Hours per week asked of the people who weed, split by sex, and whether they were paid

M-A.question: Shared schema means the software has human feelings and intentions.
USSD means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all statements that are correct: What do you send?
options: The accuracy of the model (88%) labelled as a yield increase
25%, because other countries' apps quote numbers like that
No comment, so they will invent the number without you
A short statement of who joined, what was counted, what is unknown, and an explicit refusal to invent a yield percent

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Action: Spending labour, cash, seed, feed or a registered product. A person is accountable for it.
Review: True or false? Labelled local set means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Over-confidence means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Prevalence means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: Select all accurate points from “False alarms, missed pests, and input costs”:
options: Accuracy hides FP and FN. Price both in KES and in risk.
Never tie a product pack to an app yes.
Units 1–5 are a complete, safe practice: predict, localise, read scores, scout, cost errors — people still decide.
Next: climate variability, which breaks models that assumed a stable season.

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Season split: Reporting tool results separately for long rains, short rains and dry spells instead of one average.

Review: Select all statements that are correct: What do you recommend? (Context: A county project will train 30 co-op chairs on a leaf app. Twenty-eight chairs are men. Weeding in those co-ops is mostly done by women. The project asks you if the training list i…)
options: Train only youth with smartphones, regardless of who farms
Skip training and print posters of confidence scores
Keep the list — chairs will cascade the skill at home
Add the people who weed and photograph: at least one woman per co-op with her own login, Kiswahili materials, and a time stipend if extra hours are required

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Shared schema: Agreed columns and units so one member's 90 kg bag is not another's 50 kg bag.
Review: True or false? USSD: Star-code menus on basic phones that can collect simple facts without internet.
Review: Select all statements that are correct: Which report is honest for a DigiFarm-style SMS pilot?
options: All members loved it, so measurement is unnecessary
Yields rose 40% because of AI
The model is 99% accurate, therefore farms prospered
320 of 500 numbers received the message; 40 requested an extension visit; yield effect not measured

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Prediction means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Labelled local set: Photos from your county with names agreed by people who know the crop, kept with consent.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Over-confidence: Scores sit higher than actual hit rates on real farm photos.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Prevalence: The share of plants (or animals) with the problem, for example 7 of 20.
Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: Prevalence is 10%. Of 1,000 plants, TP=90, FP=135, FN=10, TN=765. Precision (PPV) is about:
Check your understanding — According to this unit: NDVI means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Inclusion means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: Which column set best respects minimisation for a co-op leaf library?
options: Every field the vendor's form listed, just in case
M-Pesa PIN so only real farmers upload
Name, ID photo, GPS of homestead, leaf photo
Member code, ward, crop, date, leaf photo, officer-confirmed label

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Grounding means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Baseline: The measured situation before the tool: yields with units, scouting habits, costs in KES.

M-A.question: Field boundary: The polygon you claim is one plot. Wrong boundaries mix neighbours into your NDVI.
Head: The last layers you train for your classes, for example five leaf names plus unknown.
Sync-later: Queue photos and logs offline; upload when signal returns, without blocking capture.
Select all statements that are correct: Why is this unsafe?
options: Seasons do not affect leaves
Weekly training is always too expensive
It is unsafe only if you also auto-spray
You would be labelling the world with the model's own mistakes and amplifying drift

M-A.question: Open loop: The model queues a human. The human reads the label. That is the allowed architecture.
Spatial leakage means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all statements that are correct: The best primary metric for an FAW warning pilot is:
options: Social media reach of the red map
Yield percent saved versus last year
Number of bottles sold in the county
Hours from flag to first confirmed scout count, plus false-alarm rate of flags

M-A.question: Vendor-blind photos means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all statements that are correct: What is the defensible position?
options: Allow if they knock 1% off the app fee
Allow on condition they auto-approve every loan
Allow it — more products help farmers
Refuse: new purpose, likely sensitive profiling, cross-border — needs a new lawful basis, new consent, and a committee decision

M-A.question: Select all statements that are correct: What is the equitable next step?
options: Quote the 86% average in the pastoral ward so they feel included
Accept the drones — equity means the same machines everywhere
Turn the model off everywhere so no one has an advantage
Refuse drones as a substitute: fund local labels, Kiswahili/voice or SMS playbooks, and officer time; restricted deployment until slices pass

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Cloud mask means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Backbone means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Last-known-good means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Feedback loop means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Hard refusal means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Spatial leakage: Training and testing on overlapping nearby pixels so the model memorises the neighbourhood, not the crop.

Review: Select all statements that are correct: What do you advise in writing? (Context: A national dashboard turns red. A political office wants a spray week announced tomorrow for all maize counties, using whatever bottles are in stores.…)
options: Publish a 40% yield-save estimate to justify the week
Agree — red means spray
Agree only if drones do it, for precision
Refuse a blanket week: risk is not presence; playbooks are local; products must be PCPB-labelled for the pest and crop after officer confirmation

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Vendor-blind photos: Leaves picked by extension that morning, not the tablet gallery from HQ.
Review: True or false? Exit clause means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: Select all statements that are correct: The most equitable interface for a low-literacy rural scout is:
options: A printed English manual of softmax tables
An English-only dashboard
No tool at all, forever
Voice or icon-driven output in a local language, with officer confirmation

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Cloud mask: A layer that marks which satellite pixels are cloud, so you do not treat cloud as soil or crop.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Backbone: The pretrained layers that extract visual features; often frozen at first.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Last-known-good: The previous model kept on disk so a bad update can be rolled back in the field.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Feedback loop: The tool's advice changes future data, which can retrain the tool on itself.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Hard refusal: A product rule that cannot be toggled by a sales flag: no dose, no dispatch, no GPIO.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Mixed pixel means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Playbook means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Check your understanding — Select all statements that are correct: Which demo result is enough to buy for the whole county this afternoon?
options: A generator, 94% on HQ photos, and a free lunch
The model named fall armyworm once, correctly
The CEC liked the colour of the dashboard
None — afternoon signatures are not an evaluation

M-C.question: Check your understanding — According to this unit: Exit clause: What is deleted, what is returned, and who certifies it, on a date.
Check your understanding — According to this unit: Slice metric: Performance reported separately per group, not only as an average.

M-A.question: Community health promoter (CHP) means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Sensitive personal data: Personal data the law protects more strictly, including health, biometrics, ethnicity and children's data.
Danger sign means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Health rumour means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Approved health tool means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all accurate points from “What symptom checkers cannot see”:
options: Urgency on a screen is not a diagnosis and not a discharge.
Local season, available tests and what you can see beat a remote score.
Override the tool when the person in front of you looks worse than the form.
Next: clinic records, who may see them, and why they are not WhatsApp material.

M-A.question: Select all statements that are correct: Why is an approved clinic system different from a public chatbot?
options: Because public chatbots are illegal in Kenya
Because clinic systems only work in English
Because approved systems never make mistakes
Because an approved system has logins, a limited user list and a duty to keep health data inside care

M-A.question: Select all statements that are correct: What should staff do?
options: Tell her to wait at home until the county truck arrives sometime this month
Start the MOH referral pathway to the health centre that has stock, and do not let the app choose a substitute
Ask a public chatbot for a herbal alternative until next week's delivery
Follow the app and send her to any chemist for the named pack

M-A.question: Mother tongue means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Select all accurate points from “Draft a CHP education message, then review it”:
options: No person's name, ID, SHA number, HIV status, house number that points to one family, or photo.
No emergency diagnosis and no medicine name or dose.
A clear next step that follows MOH pathways: visit the CHP, go to the dispensary, or call 999, 112 or 719 if it is an emergency.
A human review line: a clinician, CHP supervisor or health records officer reads it before it is sent or pinned on a tree.

M-B.question: Review: Select all statements that are correct: What should the family do? (Context: Your little brother has had a cough for two days. Tonight he is breathing very fast and his chest pulls in with each breath. Your uncle types the symptoms into a free health app. T…)
options: Wait until morning and ask the CHP when she next visits the village
Trust the app and let him sleep, because it studied many cases
Type the symptoms into a second app and follow whichever answer sounds more serious
Get help from a health worker now, and call 999 or 112 if he gets worse or cannot breathe well

M-B.question: Review: True or false? Sensitive personal data means the software has human feelings and intentions.
Review: True or false? Emergency numbers 999 and 112: Free numbers to call in Kenya when a life may be in danger.
Review: True or false? Forward: Sending a message on to other people. Forwarding a rumour is how it grows.
Review: True or false? Redact: Remove names, numbers and other identifiers before anyone uses a tool to help with wording.
Review: True or false? Triage: Sorting people by how soon they need care. A person who can see the patient should do it.
Review: Select all accurate points from “Clinic records stay at the clinic”:
options: Clinic records exist for care and lawful planning, not for group chats.
KHIS holds summary data for the health system; that is not the same as posting a name.
Approved tools have logins and duties. Public bots do not.
Next: when the shelf is empty, forecasts can help a person order — they cannot invent stock.

M-B.question: Review: Select all statements that are correct: What is the honest job of an AI stock forecast in a dispensary?
options: To guarantee that the shelf will never be empty
To tell patients which chemist to visit when stock runs out
To replace the county supply system
To give staff a starting number so a person can count, check expiry and place the order

M-B.question: Review: Select all statements that are correct: What should they do before printing? (Context: A youth group uses a chatbot to draft a cholera-prevention poster for a market in Kisumu. The draft is fluent English. Many traders at the market are more comfortable in Kiswahili.…)
options: Let the chatbot translate at the last minute and print without review
Add Sheng slang the chatbot invented, to look closer to the market
Print the English only, because official health talk is always in English
Produce a checked Kiswahili version as well, have a health worker review both, then print

M-B.question: Review: Select all accurate points from “Draft a CHP education message, then review it”:
